senses.gloss: f. (v. קָרָא I) pumpkin-shell used as a drawing vessel, cooler.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 17:6">Sabb. XVII, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 125a:16">125ᵃ</cite>) <he>האבן שבקי׳</he> (Y. ed. <cite ref="S01164"><he>קֵירוּיָא</he></cite>; Ms. M. <he>קֵרוּיָיא</he>) the stone which is put into a drawing vessel (to weight it); ib. 125ᵇ <he>שבקרויה</he> (Ms. M. <he>שבקריא</he>, corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Chullin 57b:14">Ḥull. 57ᵇ</cite> (Ms. M. <he>קרא</he>); <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 3:5">Kel. III, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 3:3">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. III, 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00665"><he>חִידּוּק</he></cite>; a. e.
